method: Local HTTP, headless browsers, native requestAnimationFrame. Sequential ABBA within each viewport, fresh process per block, 4 full switches per block. P95 nearest rank per switch. Forced GPU waits for initialization before the first timed switch.

desktopWebGLDrawTimer.method: EXT_disjoint_timer_query_webgl2, around drawElements every 8th call. Asynchronous collection; disjoint samples excluded. No buffer/texture uploads, browser composition or display timing in this interval.

imageCheck.method: Fixed pose screenshots at 1080x740 CSS px, DPR 1. Compare all x and 128 <= y < 625. Silhouette mask = max RGB channel difference vs hidden-canvas background >4. RGB differences calculated on shared ink/paper mask. Printed-stock control disables the sampled texture's opacity and otherwise draws the same GPU pose. Ink changed if any channel differs by at least 3.

articles.title: 纸上生风。
articles.paragraph: 午后折了一只纸鹤。拇指压住翼根，轻轻提起纸尖，桌面上便多了一道细长的影子。

articles.title: 河岸余晖。
articles.paragraph: 走到桥下，太阳只剩半枚。对岸的树影铺上水面，一艘小船经过，把银灰色的天光分成两行。
